candidates.title: dunnhumby launches network alliance to connect and scale retail media across retailers
candidates.why_product_decision: The biggest structural block on commerce media — fragmentation across separate retailer networks — is being solved with a single cross-retailer activation route (Tesco, B&Q, John Lewis, Waitrose in pilots; tech partner Kevel) and shared standards for measurement and reporting. Reshapes how a bank/commerce-media proposition positions on reach and measurement.
candidates.notes: Announced 19 Jun 2026. Pilots begin 'this summer' across household/DIY, health & beauty, grocery. Corroborated: Grocery Gazette (19 Jun), Retail Gazette, The Grocer, Retail Technology Innovation Hub (18 Jun).

candidates.title: SMG launches RMX — the UK's first retail media exchange platform
candidates.why_product_decision: A shared exchange/activation-and-measurement layer that lets brands buy across multiple retail media networks through one entry point while retailers keep control of pricing, inventory and data — the interoperability layer a bank media network would plug into rather than build alone.
candidates.notes: RMX by Plan-Apps, built with Empathy Lab by EPAM. Date given as early-June (exact day not confirmed; 403 to automated fetch but resolves in-browser and indexed). Supporting piece to the dunnhumby alliance in the same trend.

candidates.title: Asda becomes first retailer outside the US to license Amazon Retail Ad Service
candidates.why_product_decision: Amazon exporting its ad stack to a UK grocer (Asda.com + George, rollout from Q4 2026) puts Amazon-grade ad tech and measurement inside a UK retail media network — raising the technical bar every commerce-media seller is benchmarked against.
candidates.notes: Announced 23 Jun 2026. Asda licenses Amazon's stack to power sponsored products; not buying ads on Amazon. Corroborated: Grocery Gazette (25 Jun), Retail-Insight-Network, ESM, Retail Technology Innovation Hub.

candidates.title: Nectar360 becomes first UK retail media network to achieve IAB Europe Retail Media Certification
candidates.why_product_decision: An independent, audited certification for retail media measurement (Nectar360 first in the UK, via ABC audit) turns commerce-media measurement from a vendor claim into a standard a proposition can be measured against — directly relevant to how a bank/CLO media offer proves its numbers.
candidates.notes: Announced 1 Jul 2026. Covers off-site display/video (Meta, Google DV360, YouTube). Nectar360 also reporting early results on 'Pollen' unified platform with Unilever and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners. UK retail media ad spend forecast to top £4.8bn in 2026 (up from ~£4bn 2025). Corroborated: Retail Gazette, ExchangeWire, DecisionMarketing, FMCG Magazine.

candidates.title: Shopify Spring '26 removes the approval gate — any developer can register an agent profile and call the public MCP endpoint (UCP)
candidates.why_product_decision: The agent-checkout surface is now open to millions of merchants with no approval gate (agent profiles + public MCP endpoint, UCP co-developed with Google, trust tiers unlock direct checkout) — but loyalty, offers, discounts and rewards are NOT first-class objects in it. The evidenced gap the category has to answer.
candidates.notes: Confirmed via WebFetch 17 Jun 2026. Article explicitly does not mention loyalty/offers/rewards as first-class objects. Pairs with the 10 Jun networks trust-layer moves (Issue 1) as the platform-side evolution.

candidates.title: Emirates NBD launches Rewards Hub — a unified in-app marketplace on ENBD X
candidates.outlet: Zawya (Emirates NBD press release); primary: emiratesnbd.com newsroom
candidates.why_product_decision: The largest UAE bank consolidating rewards, travel, shopping, gifting and lifestyle into a single in-app marketplace (built with Vernost) — the 'bank-as-lifestyle-super-app' benchmark in the reader's GCC sales region, deciding where redemption value gets surfaced and who powers it.
candidates.notes: Launched 10 Jun 2026. Vernost Marketing Technology Solutions. Launch: up to 15% off flights/hotels/Apple; AED 10,000 weekly draw for 12 weeks; pay by card / points / part-payment / instalments. Merchant onboarding in-window (Fnp.ae gifting joined 29 Jun).

candidates.title: Mashreq launches 'Everyday Cashback' — Visa card-linked offers powered by Rezolve Ai (debit and credit)
candidates.why_product_decision: A tier-1 UAE bank shipped automated, merchant-funded card-linked cashback (up to 20%, first time on debit as well as credit) bought from a third-party vendor (Rezolve Ai) — a sourced instantiation of the reader's exact product, deployed by a prospect/competitor bank in the expansion region.
candidates.notes: Announced 22 Jun 2026 (WebFetch confirmed). Fully digital, personalised, in-app cashback tracking. Branded evolution of Mashreq's rewards; extends benefits to debit cardholders for the first time.

candidates.title: Barclays summer switching offer pivots Premier reward value to a £600 'experience' (vs £200 cash)
candidates.outlet: MoneyfactsCompare (primary: Barclays newsroom, 403 to bots, resolves in-browser)
candidates.why_product_decision: A UK high-street bank substituting curated experiences (Michelin dining, hotel stays, entertainment) for cash as the headline reward is a live signal that premium reward value is moving from cashback toward experiences — a positioning axis a pure cashback/CLO proposition doesn't compete on.
candidates.notes: Offer live 9 Jun–27 Aug 2026. Two-tier: £200 cash (standard) or £600 experience (Premier). Weekly 'Barclays Experiences' (GAIL's, 4 months Apple Music). Corroborated MoneyfactsCompare + MSE forum. Announcement 9 Jun is one day pre-strict-window but the offer runs through the window.

candidates.title: ING Spain adopts Revolut/N26-style paid subscription tiers with rewards baked into higher tiers
candidates.why_product_decision: An incumbent European bank moving to four paid tiers (Go/More/Extra/Max) with rewards in the higher tiers packages loyalty as membership rather than transaction cashback — a different monetisation model for reward value that competes with standalone CLO/cashback.
candidates.notes: 10 Jun 2026, Spanish-language regional press. Explicitly mirrors Revolut/N26/Bunq premium-plan playbook. Flag as Spain.

candidates.title: PayPal Rewards moves to closed-loop — cash redemption ends, active opt-in required (US)
candidates.outlet: PayPal (help centre); opt-in reported by Value Added Resource
candidates.why_product_decision: PayPal killing cash-out and forcing points into in-ecosystem redemption is a cautionary redemption-UX and reward-liability signal — a data point for anyone weighing closed-loop vs open-loop reward value against consumer-backlash risk.
candidates.notes: Cash-back redemption ends 1 Aug 2026; opt-in reported ~29 Jun. US programme. In-window movement is the transition taking effect.

candidates.title: Bank of America bundles referral bonuses, instalment 'Custom Pay Plan' and credit monitoring into rewards (US)
candidates.why_product_decision: 'Rewards' broadening into a relationship bundle (referral + BNPL-style instalments + credit health) shows a major bank redefining reward scope beyond cashback — context for how a CLO/cashback proposition might be bundled.
candidates.notes: 10 Jun 2026. Builds on BofA Rewards (enrolment opened May 2026). US-only. Also-moving one-liner.

candidates.title: Paytm x AU Small Finance Bank launch co-branded credit card with UPI-weighted rewards (India)
candidates.why_product_decision: A super-app deepening a bank card tie-up and steering rewards toward first-party ecosystem spend (Paytm UPI, Travel, Gold) — the super-app-as-rewards-gravity pattern relevant to Asian go-to-market.
candidates.notes: 3 Jul 2026. Paytm's third co-brand (after HDFC, SBI). Up to 2% on Paytm UPI, 5% on Paytm Travel/Gold, zero annual fee. Also-moving one-liner.

candidates.title: IHG x Revolut debit-card rewards promotion (UK) — hotel loyalty earn via a neobank card
candidates.why_product_decision: A hotel loyalty programme tying earn to a neobank debit card (Revolut) is a card-linked reward-distribution precedent via a fintech wallet rather than a legacy bank — a partner-model data point.
candidates.notes: Promo window 30 Jun–25 Aug 2026. Secondary-sourced (newswire); lower confidence, no primary IHG/Revolut confirmation fetched. Also-moving one-liner only.

quiet_findings.competitor_set: Largely quiet in-window. No in-window Cardlytics, Reward (rewardinsight), Fidel API, Triple, Snoop or Bink product/partnership announcement found. Mastercard/Visa/Amex offers stacks: the only in-window network moves were the agentic-payments items (10 Jun, carried in Issue 1); no new personalised-offers stack launch. CLO infra vendors generated only evergreen explainer content this window.
quiet_findings.uk_bank_set: Quiet after last month's flurry. Barclays (summer experiences switch, 9 Jun) is the one genuinely new UK bank item. Lloyds Rewards is the SAME hub covered in Issue 1 (primary release 9 Jun; in-window coverage is secondary/'replaces Everyday Offers') — recurrence, not new movement; noted in Also moving, not re-featured. NatWest, HSBC/First Direct, Santander, Nationwide, Virgin Money, TSB, Monzo, Starling, Revolut, Chase: no qualifying in-window rewards/loyalty LAUNCH (Chase's overhaul and NatWest's Reward renewal both pre-window).
quiet_findings.experience_surface: Agentic/A2A/wallet from Issue 1 mostly quiet on NEW movement: Google AP2/UCP/Universal Cart (Apr–May), Talon.One UIP (Jan), Samsung Wallet, UKPI (2 Jun, pre-window) — no fresh in-window event. The ONE fresh agentic delta is Shopify Spring '26 (17 Jun) opening the agent-checkout surface to every merchant. Apple Wallet iOS 27 (WWDC, ~10 Jun) had incremental loyalty-pass detail but is the same WWDC covered in Issue 1.
quiet_findings.region: ME strongest (Emirates NBD, Mashreq). Europe thin (ING Spain the one concrete move; no new BBVA/Santander/Revolut/N26/Bunq launch). Asia thin (Paytm x AU the one co-brand; no new Grab/GoTo/Alipay/WeChat/DBS/OCBC/UOB loyalty launch). Saudi: only ongoing programmes.
